source: Commit-level changes on beamfall/corvint origin/main, all ancestors of 8daec98ce4349c1583186692726d2c3a782ac647, selected 2026-10-31 for V1-0805 from git log by ticket ID; follow-up commits were found with git log --grep on the same ticket ID.
adapter: changed-path reference adapter (historicalAdapter in historical_test.go): a source file is a .go/.mjs/.js/.sh file that is not a test file; affected flows are the directories of changed source files; a test gap is a directory with a changed source file and no changed test file; no documentation targets or defects; with test gaps and a follow-up commit it authors the follow-up's test files as the tests draft. Directory identifiers replace / with : and the repository root with root.

label_definitions.affected_flows: generated: every directory holding a changed non-test file of the change, in the adapter's identifier form
label_definitions.followup: generated: true when a later origin/main commit carrying the same ticket ID changed code, tests or specs for the change
label_definitions.test_gaps: generated: directories whose tests a later same-ticket commit changed although the change itself changed no test file there
label_definitions.defects: generated: line-anchored defects named by a later same-ticket fix; empty where no line anchor exists (see uncertainty)
